text:
maria_devex: Heads up — noticed SDK 1.12.0 changed client-side shared cache invalidation timing. Some internal routing tests are failing...
chris_platform: ugh, that's the one that moved cache expiry from 'immediate' to 'buffered' right? any repro logs?
sam_sdk: yeah, change was to reduce thundering herd by buffering invalidations 500ms. Intended safe but looks like route-affinity tokens are getting stale.
taylor_infra: can you paste a short trace? maybe the console telemetry will show increased fallback rates.
sam_sdk: paste log:
```
INFO route=us-west-2 model=titanx token=abc123 cache_invalidate=scheduled delay=500ms
WARN route_affinity_miss fallback=true
```
jenna_pm: How widespread? Does this affect dedicated customers or just hosted?
maria_devex: repro on both hosted and dedicated dev clusters. Dedicated has longer token TTLs so more visible in canary.
chris_platform: This interacts with quotas too — if the route affinity misses we hit different quota buckets and console graphs spike. Need to decide rollback vs patch.
sam_sdk: Proposed fixes: 1) revert buffering (fast rollback), 2) add explicit route-claim handshake before buffered invalidation, 3) expose opt-in flag in SDK config (client-side compatibility).
taylor_infra: Opt-in flag is safest for staged rollout, but requires SDK release and doc updates. Revert is faster.
jenna_pm: Risk: Revert will fix immediate issues but lose the herd protection. Timeline? Revert patch today, then opt-in rollout in next minor.
maria_devex: Also need telemetry tag to distinguish buffered invalidations so console shows impact. Right now rollback will make the anomaly disappear and we lose signal.
chris_platform: Action items:
- sam_sdk: cut a 1.12.1 revert patch and publish (ETA 3h)
- devex: add dashboard tile for "route_affinity_miss" and tag events (ETA EOD)
- infra: prepare canary rollback plan for dedicated pools (ETA 6h)
- jenna_pm: notify SRE and sales for customers on dedicated (ETA 1h)
sam_sdk: started branch rollback now. will ping when published.
deploy-bot: Deploy started for sdk-1.12.1-revert -> npm, pypi, go modules
maria_devex: i'll draft the release note and the console alert rule. tagging @everyone in ded pool channels after deploy.
chris_platform: Thanks — after rollback we'll instrument telemetry and design the opt-in handshake path for the next minor. keep thread here for updates.
